name: Web search
summary: Search the public web and return ranked titles, URLs and snippets through FRIDAY's built-in browser engine.
author: friday-core
description: Read-only web search. Runs as the built-in web.search skill (electron/skills.cjs → electron/browser.cjs DuckDuckGo HTML). No second HTTP client. Catalog pack stays disabled until the owner enables it; the builtin remains available to agents.
